decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The linked PR [ev-1cdcd7438621] says what the one-line changelog entry [ev-4aa7e3fe937e] leaves out. The Gateway API provider now supports custom HTTP filters through `ExtensionRef`, and for now the only supported target is a Traefik Middleware served by the KubernetesCRD provider. That is enough to write the applicability condition: environments using the Gateway API provider whose HTTPRoute filters use an ExtensionRef to a Middleware, with the KubernetesCRD provider enabled. The changed files [ev-fd9bf22e87d8] fit this: gateway provider code, a CRD provider change and a static config change. The same PR also makes the provider check that KubernetesCRD is started before handling `TraefikService`. The evidence does not say what happens when it is not started, so that side effect would need its own item, but it does not block deciding this feature's applicability.
